blocks.title: Hero Simple

props.name: description
props.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

props.name: image

props.docs: alt text of the picture; none: the title

props.name: imageDark
props.docs: address of the picture in the dark theme; none: image

props.docs: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

props.name: actionHref
props.docs: the address of the action

props.name: secondaryActionHref
props.docs: the address of the second action

props.name: level
props.docs: the level of the heading (1 on the first section of a page)

props.name: padding
props.docs: the vertical padding of the section: compact (py-8 lg:py-16), standard (py-16 lg:py-32), spacious (py-24 lg:py-40)

props.name: align
props.docs: the alignment of the copy: start, center or end (logical, follows the writing direction): items-* on the column, text-* on the text

props.name: padding
props.docs: the vertical padding of the section: compact (py-8 lg:py-16), standard (py-16 lg:py-32), spacious (py-24 lg:py-40)

props.name: align
props.docs: the alignment of the copy: start, center or end (logical, follows the writing direction): items-* on the column, text-* on the text

props.name: landmarkLabel
props.docs: accessible name of the landmark of this component when the page shows it more than once (a variant); replaces the heading name of the root landmark, follows the name of a nested one

variants.label: Rows, the price at the end
